title: sealedEnrollment
responsibility: Checks a browser device against its approved chain pin and matches cached keys to signed commitments.

inputs.name: verifiedEnrollment.account
inputs.description: Verified Google actor ID used to partition the browser cache.

inputs.name: verifiedEnrollment.enrollment
inputs.description: This browser device and the signed chain entries used to verify its access.

inputs.name: adoptSealedEnrollment.account
inputs.description: Verified Google actor ID used to partition the browser cache.

inputs.name: adoptSealedEnrollment.enrollment
inputs.description: This browser device and the signed chain entries used to verify its access.

inputs.name: adoptSealedEnrollment.approval
inputs.description: Chain head and sequence received through trusted device approval.

inputs.name: committedKeys.keys
inputs.description: Optional cached CryptoKey pair and commitment for one scope epoch.

inputs.name: committedKeys.commitment
inputs.description: Signed base64url commitment to the scope key pair at the requested epoch.

outputs.name: verifiedEnrollment
outputs.description: Verified signed device state corresponding to the browser’s stored chain.

outputs.name: adoptSealedEnrollment
outputs.description: True when the approved, active browser device was saved. False when its identity or prior enrollment conflicts.

outputs.name: committedKeys
outputs.description: True when the cached keys are non-extractable and match the chain commitment.
